title: SOS burst allowance + 4.29 Retry-After + monotonic default clock
description: SosResource rate limiter rework per sos_rate_limiting.json vectors: hourly(3) gate first; cooldown anchored at period start (new period when now-period_start>=600s); burst = max 2 msgs per cooldown period; retry_after=ceil(period_start+600-now) in CBOR payload {retry_after:N}+content_format CBOR. Keep check_rate_limit bool wrapper over new evaluate returning (allowed,retry_after,reason). Default time_func -> time.monotonic. Update legacy unit tests in test_sos_resource.py that encode blanket-cooldown (within_cooldown_blocked, different_sources, post_rate_limited) to vector semantics.
